import time, random
from bisect import bisect_left, bisect_right, insort

rnd = random.Random(1)
N = 60000
# sorted list with bisect+insert
t0=time.perf_counter()
keys=[]
items=[]
perm = list(range(N))
rnd.shuffle(perm)
for k in perm:
    i = bisect_left(keys, k)
    keys.insert(i, k)
    items.insert(i, k)
t1=time.perf_counter()
print("sortedlist 60k inserts:", t1-t0)

t0=time.perf_counter()

t0=time.perf_counter()
